args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 18%, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). The SRE agent rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Next step: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression (v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging).

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions. It's now passing health checks.

- **What went wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. It's now live in all three regions. After the rollback the service reports healthy, and the error rate dropped to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** I opened INC-0001 as a SEV2 for checkout-api, which paged on-call. It describes the failing deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0 and the recovery. It also notes that the root cause of the v2.3.1 problem still needs to be found. The test build (v2.3.1-rc) was also unhealthy in staging before v2.3.1 went to production.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
